name: Prague
about: Spring and fall are mild and quieter, December brings famous Christmas markets, summer is warm and busiest.
overview: Gothic spires and a UNESCO old town on the Vltava River, one of Central Europe's best-preserved capitals.
costOverview: Beer, coffee, and trams all stay notably cheap for a European capital — prices climb fast right on the Charles Bridge tourist route.

costItems.label: Beef in cream sauce (svíčková), local pub

specialSeasons.text: Christmas markets fill the Old Town Square with mulled wine, crafts and festive lights.
